title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theatre on 1977-04-27
source: FM Cast WNEW FM ->Reel Tapes -> Many Years of Playback ->Sound Forge 6.0-> +4.0DB/2.5 octave bell spread centered at 5Khz-> FLAC via Flac Frontend, level 6, sectors aligned and verified

ai_review.summary: Good FM broadcast capture with solid sound and a sweet second set highlighted by Music Never Stopped and Scarlet Fire
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from an old FM radio broadcast, delivers clear audio that listeners find “good” to “great,” despite the lack of a full first‑set. Musically the show shines in the second half, with standout performances of Music Never Stopped and a combined Scarlet/Fire track, while the missing Good Lovin’ isn’t seen as a major loss.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong positive reviews (4‑ and 5‑star) emphasize excellent music and decent sound, balanced against limited technical detail and only three total reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note the sound is good/great; no specific issues like drop‑outs or muddiness are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set largely skipped by a reviewer, but the second set is praised as sweet and engaging, making the overall flow enjoyable.
